Brazil
Consular help: Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Washington
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Federal Republic of Brazil up to 90 days, from first date of entry, for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
The citizens of Brazil, who have a valid ordinary passports, are exempted from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit , transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina for a period not exceeding 90 days , provided that the total length of stay does not exceed 180 days per year , from the first entry into the country.
The citizens of Brazil, holders of diplomatic and service passports, shall be exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days.
